messages:
oliver: Heads-up — small repro for an ESM/CJS interop break we hit when bundling the JS SDK for edge with Vite. It works in node but fails in the browser/edge build.

oliver: Steps: create a vite + edge worker sample app, install @redwood/inference-js@0.12.0, import like `import Inference from '@redwood/inference-js'` and call new Inference().

oliver: Build error snippet:
```\nTypeError: _inference_js__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__.default is not a constructor\n    at module.exports (main.js:1234)\n```

maria: ugh classic default export vs namespace. Vite + rollup sometimes rewrites interop and mangles `.default` access for CJS-built packages.
sam: Can you paste the package export map or the SDK entry? is the SDK published as CJS or dual? that matters.
oliver: SDK package.json has "main": "dist/index.cjs.js", "module": "dist/index.esm.js", exports map includes both. But the esm entry still does `module.exports =` in the built file (looks like a miscompiled rollup config).
john: If dist/index.esm.js contains `module.exports =` that's the problem — a file called .esm but using CJS syntax. Bundlers assume ESM semantics.
ashley: Quick repro I tried: clone https://github.com/redwood/repro-edge-sdk-default-imports, run `npm i && npm run dev` and open the edge worker. I see the same runtime throw.
oliver: Repro repo link: https://github.com/redwood/repro-edge-sdk-default-imports (minimal vite + worker + sample import)
sam: Temporary workaround: `import * as Inference from '@redwood/inference-js'` and then use `new (Inference as any).default?.()` or `const Impl = ('default' in Inference) ? (Inference as any).default : Inference; new Impl()` — ugly but works across bundlers.
maria: Could we add a named export wrapper in the published build: `export { default as RedwoodInference } from './cjs-wrapper.js'` so consumers can do `import { RedwoodInference } from '@redwood/inference-js'` and avoid default interop? 
john: Also we should audit build step: ensure rollup output for esm is truly ESM (uses `export default`) not `module.exports =`. Maybe babel/ts config leaking.
oliver: I can open a PR with two things: 1) quick npm release that fixes the esm build to use `export default` and 2) add a README note for edge sample apps recommending `import * as` until fixed.
dev-bot: @oliver assigned issue #512 to oliver — "esm/cjs edge import interop repro and fix" :white_check_mark:

ashley: test plan: add a vite + worker smoke test to CI that builds sample app with latest SDK, run vite build, run node-based worker runner to verify no `default is not a constructor` errors.
sam: Also add a unit that checks dist/index.esm.js contains `export default` pattern and warn on `module.exports`.
maria: sounds good. I can help review the PR. small follow-ups: check rollup-plugin-commonjs options and tsconfig module settings.
oliver: I'll have a draft PR by EOD. Thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
